evidence.reason: At the current tip, `discard()` still unconditionally writes a cleanup warning to `sys.stderr` when unlinking the partial file fails. `download()` calls `discard()` from its failure path before re-raising, so a machine-mode (`--json`) run can produce the JSON error on stdout while also emitting this warning on stderr, violating current contract item 2 (`stderr stays empty` in machine mode). The diagnostic should be attached to the primary exception or emitted by a machine-aware handler.
